Both moved steps went to groups 3 and 0, the groups with recorded 20.2-minute cap cancellations (runs 44915291684, 44917124015), and nothing went to group 2.
  WHY: Group 3 at 20.2 min plus about 1.2 min is about 21.4 min, roughly one minute under the 22m30s budget-watch threshold (0.75 x 30 min; scripts/ci_budget_watch.py line 56), so this likely triggers the next budget-watch issue. The reviewer rated this MAJOR. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash checked the same lines and declined to report it: the cancellations predate #9916's raise to 30 min, and recent shard times of 15.0-17.1 min (run 44914391485) leave about 4 min of headroom.

The heaviest step, "Regression tests wired by the CI wiring guard (part 2)" (ci.yml:2979, ~162s per ci.yml lines 4347-4350), stays in the job to avoid reversing #9214 (ci.yml lines 4350-4352), and no other step was moved to make up the gap.
